purpose: Four-row structural form smoke of cell AGREE: that the agreement signal loads, that the boundary channel still delivers eight entries, that every request fits and that the episode completes. It is scored by no one and read by no one: four rows can never be evidence of benefit. The intent-boundary Perception channel's rank policy reads its own w_agree term over a pre-computed, self-excluded exemplar-intent vote: w_agree 1.0, the DELIVERED width unchanged at 8 entries (fuse_coverage m 8 / c 1 / top_l 8). The RECALL width moves from 8 to the store's full 60, because PhaseSupplySpec.k is the provider's top_k_per_dimension and truncates by cosine BEFORE the ranker runs -- left at 8 the agreement term can only permute the eight the cosine already chose and the change is inert (measured: 45.0 % -> 45.0 % wrong-row delivery on all three rosters). Widening the recall alone is a proven no-op: the in-chain A/A control carries k 60 at w_agree 0.0 and reproduces the sealed comparator's own first-phase output digest exactly, so the two arms differ in w_agree alone. Authority: the model-free read docs/results/2026-09-26-slurp-intent-retrieval-rank-diagnostic.md, whose section 6 selection rule picked this candidate out of 27 by a rule fixed before the numbers were read (a gain on all three rosters, correct-row delivery loss at most one point, token-neutral, smallest weight). Measured delivery of the row's own gold-intent boundary entry on intent-wrong rows: TRAIN Fold A 45.0 % to 81.7 %, with a floor of +30.4 points on the two rosters the weight was not fitted on, and correct-row delivery rising to 98.2-99.6 %. Measured token cost +1.4 tokens per row against the flown 1,195.4-token block; the k=30 alternative buys the same delivery for +3,262.3, about 2,330 times the form cost that sank the index arm at SLU -7.37. DELIVERY IS NOT CORRECTNESS: the conversion rate is unmeasured.
